zh.lead: 今天最大的产品消息：OpenAI 今早发出科学博客首篇，Nathaniel Craig 讲述他与 GPT-6 Astra 合作给出标准模型的候选格点定义；OpenClaw 已打出 v2026.11.5-beta.4 标签，CHANGELOG 已更新，但 Releases 页尚未挂出。

important.title: 重要消息
items: OpenAI 于北京时间今早 08:23 转发 11/15 的科学博客首篇。Craig 写到，他用更细网格修正相位的策略尚未完成证明；Astra 给出了把力场搬到更细网格的方法，并主导了详细证明。这是候选定义，仍需同行检验，尚不能直接用于大规模模拟。
OpenClaw 标签 v2026.11.5-beta.4 相对 beta.3 超前 38 个提交，CHANGELOG 计 55 个 PR。新功能仅一条：把交互组件渲染为 Telegram 消息；其余多为记忆、自动化与更新回滚等修复。采集时 Releases 页仍为 404，故以仓库 CHANGELOG 为准。
CursorBench 4.0 较昨日无更新，官方得分仍由 Gemini 4 Carbon High（60.4%）领跑，性价比头部仍是 GPT-5.6 Luna Low 与 Haiku 5.5 Low。

sections.title: OpenAI 这篇科学博文写了什么
sections.body: 标准模型在连续时空仍缺少非微扰定义，弱相互作用的手征性让格点化很困难。Astra 把更细网格上的相位修正做成可证明的构造，经专家审读；反射正定性与连续极限仍待解决。

sections.title: OpenClaw beta.4 改了什么
sections.body: 这是 beta.3 之后的可靠性补丁。除 Telegram 组件外，修复覆盖记忆导出、自动化连续性、更新回滚和附件处理。今日不以未发布的 Release 正文表述。

sections.title: 产品栏
sections.body: Hermes 稳定版仍为 v0.23.1，周日 canary 首次带上插件目录 Features。Harness 仍为 rc.3；codex 稳定版仍为 0.169.0，实验线到 alpha.7。Claude 与 Cursor changelog 无新条目。Grok Bot changelog 仍为 v1.0.1，cask 仍报 1.1.0。

sections.title: 缺口
sections.body: 关注列表中多数账号近 48 小时无高信号原创，也无 DeepSeek 一手 X。OpenAI 新闻页今日抓取偏挑战页；OpenClaw Releases 页尚未挂出。不编造 Grok 1.1.0 与实验标签未写明的功能。

en.lead: Biggest product news today: OpenAI published the first post on its science blog, in which Nathaniel Craig describes working with GPT-6 Astra on a candidate lattice definition of the Standard Model; OpenClaw now has the v2026.11.5-beta.4 tag and an updated CHANGELOG, but the Releases page is not up yet.

important.title: Headlines
items: At 08:23 Asia/Shanghai, OpenAI pointed to the Nov 15 science-blog essay. Craig writes that his finer-grid phase strategy was not fully proved; Astra proposed how to carry the force fields onto finer grids and led the detailed proof. He presents a candidate that still needs scrutiny and is not yet usable for large-scale simulations.

OpenClaw's v2026.11.5-beta.4 tag is 38 commits ahead of beta.3; the CHANGELOG counts 55 PRs. The only new feature is rendering interactive widgets as Telegram messages; most of the rest are fixes for memory, automation, and failed-update rollback. The Releases page still returned 404, so this follows the in-repo CHANGELOG.
CursorBench 4.0 is unchanged versus yesterday: the official scoreboard is still led by Gemini 4 Carbon High (60.4%), and the value leaders remain GPT-5.6 Luna Low and Haiku 5.5 Low.

sections.title: What the OpenAI science post actually claims
sections.body: The Standard Model still lacks a nonperturbative definition in continuous spacetime, and the chirality of the weak interaction makes lattice formulations hard. Astra turned finer-grid phase corrections into a provable construction, which experts then reviewed. Reflection positivity and the continuum limit remain open.

sections.title: What OpenClaw beta.4 changes
sections.body: This is a reliability patch after beta.3. Besides Telegram widgets, the fixes cover memory export, automation continuity, failed-update rollback, and attachment handling. Today's brief does not treat an unpublished GitHub Release body as the source.

sections.title: Product desk
sections.body: Hermes stable remains v0.23.1; Sunday's canary is the first with a plugin-catalog Features list. Harness is still rc.3. Codex stable remains 0.169.0; the experimental line moved to alpha.7. Claude and the Cursor changelog have no new entries. Grok Bot's changelog is still v1.0.1, and the cask still reports 1.1.0.

sections.title: Gaps
sections.body: Most follow-list accounts had no high-signal originals in the past 48 hours, and there is still no first-party DeepSeek account on X. OpenAI's news page fetched as a challenge page; the OpenClaw Releases page is not up yet. No features are invented for Grok 1.1.0 or the experimental tags beyond what their notes say.

title.zh: 迈向在格点上定义标准模型
title.en: A step toward defining the Standard Model on a lattice

summary.zh: OpenAI 科学博客首篇客座文章（标注 11/15，今早由官方账号转发）。UCSB 粒子理论组负责人、OpenAI 访问科学家 Nathaniel Craig 记述：他在 10 月预印本中提出候选格点定义，但相位规则的证明原先并不完整；GPT-6 Astra 帮助把「把力场放到更细网格上比较并累加修正」做成构造，并在详细证明上起了主导作用。格点场论专家 Maarten Golterman、Andreas Kronfeld 与 Yigal Shamir 审读了证明。作者强调这是候选方案，仍需同行检验，也还不能直接用于现实规模模拟；反射正定性与连续极限仍待解决。文中配图由 Craig / GPT-6 Astra 提供。预印本链接在今日抓取的页面中未能稳定解析，故不编造 arXiv 编号，正文以官方博文为准。
summary.en: The first guest post on OpenAI’s science blog (dated Nov 15; surfaced by the official account this morning). Nathaniel Craig, who leads the particle-theory group at UC Santa Barbara and is a visiting scientist at OpenAI, describes an October preprint with a candidate lattice definition whose phase rule he had not fully proved. GPT-6 Astra helped turn the “place the force fields on finer grids, compare, and add the corrections” idea into a construction and led the detailed proof. Lattice field theorists Maarten Golterman, Andreas Kronfeld, and Yigal Shamir reviewed it. He presents a candidate, not a finished practical method for realistic-scale simulations; reflection positivity and the continuum limit remain open. Figures are credited to Craig / GPT-6 Astra. The preprint URL could not be parsed reliably from today’s page fetch, so no arXiv id is invented; the official post is the source.

alphaxivTop3.title: Unbundling Multimodal Vision Encoding
alphaxivTop3.authors: Ellis Brown, Chris Hoang, Shengyi Qian, Shang-Wen Li, Mike Lewis, Marjan Ghazvininejad, Luke Zettlemoyer, Lucas Beyer, Mengye Ren, Jakob Verbeek, Saining Xie, Hu Xu et al.

summary.zh: （热榜第 1，较昨日仍居首位）把多模态模型里视觉编码器的三项设计拆开对照：上游预训练带来的视觉先验、专用视觉容量，以及融合前放置。在统一数据与算力下从头训练后发现：视觉先验并非必要，联合从头训练的编码器可与预训练编码器相当；真正关键的是专用视觉容量，无编码器方案即使把骨干做大仍落后，但这些容量不必放在融合之前。
summary.en: (Still #1 on alphaXiv’s trending list versus yesterday.) A controlled study that unbundles three choices in multimodal vision encoding: the visual prior from upstream pretraining, dedicated vision capacity, and whether that capacity sits before fusion. Trained from scratch on common data at matched compute, a jointly trained encoder matches a pretrained one — the visual prior is not necessary. Dedicated vision capacity is what matters; encoder-free models still trail even with a larger backbone, but that capacity need not precede fusion.

alphaxivTop3.title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier: Scaling Law for Latent Feedback Transformers on Repeated Data
alphaxivTop3.authors: Benhao Huang, Chaitanya Dwivedi, Xuezhe Ma, Alexander Moreno, Hector Liu

summary.zh: （热榜第 2，较昨日仍居第 2）高质量数据耗尽后，常见做法是多轮重复训练，但每一轮的收益递减。本文研究潜空间反馈（把当前 token 顶层状态送入下一 token 输入）作为一种把算力花在重复数据上的方式，并给出在重复数据上的缩放律，称其可放大算力与数据效率。
summary.en: (Still #2 today, same as yesterday.) When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. The paper studies latent feedback — feeding each token’s top-layer state into the next token’s input — as another way to spend that compute on repeated data, and reports a scaling law in which latent feedback acts as a compute and data amplifier.

alphaxivTop3.title: SLAM Dunk: A Recipe for Long-Horizon Egocentric SLAM in the Wild

summary.zh: （热榜第 3，新上榜；昨日第 3 的 Ropedia Xperience 2 降至第 8。标注日期 11/15）标准视觉惯性里程计在野外长轨迹、尤其是第一人称设定下精度难维持，LaMAria 基准上与工业系统有明显差距。常规离线 bundle adjustment 能补上大部分差距，但仍停在公开强提交的水平、低于 Aria 的 SLAM。作者认为缺口来自相机标定漂移与陀螺本征标定。SLAM Dunk 把这些传感器效应纳入管道，成为首个在 LaMAria 五个测试类别中的三个上超过 Aria SLAM 的方法，提交时还在 UZH-FPV 榜上取得第一。代码见 github.com/jacobvm04/slam-dunk。
summary.en: (New to the top 3 at #3; yesterday’s #3, Ropedia Xperience 2, falls to #8. Dated Nov 15.) Standard visual-inertial odometry struggles to stay accurate on long in-the-wild trajectories, especially in egocentric settings, as the gap versus industry systems on LaMAria shows. A conventional offline bundle-adjustment pipeline closes much of that gap but plateaus at strong public submissions, still well below Aria’s SLAM. The authors attribute the rest to camera-calibration drift and gyroscope intrinsic calibration. SLAM Dunk models those sensor effects and is the first to outperform Aria’s SLAM on three of five LaMAria test categories; it also placed first on the UZH-FPV leaderboard at submission. Code: github.com/jacobvm04/slam-dunk.

The GitHub Releases page still returned Not Found at collection time, so this follows the tag and the in-repo CHANGELOG. Fixes cover paged export and large-index rebuilds of session memory, automation continuity and privacy rechecks, rolling back updates that fail install/startup, keeping transcript reads available and binary attachments out of prompts, Claude approvals and provider recovery, database backup isolation, plus Control UI, Gateway, and mobile/voice. summary.zh: 自昨日早报之后，Anthropic 新闻页与可核对的产品稿无新条目。仍以 11/12 的 Claude Meetings（Team / Enterprise beta，先支持 Google Meet）以及同日进入私人预览的自托管 Claude Managed Agents 为最近产品动态。今日无新的 Claude 或 Anthropic 官方 X 原创。
summary.en: No new product post on Anthropic’s newsroom or a verifiable changelog since yesterday’s brief. The latest product news remains Claude Meetings from Nov 12 (beta on Team and Enterprise, starting with Google Meet) and self-hosted Claude Managed Agents entering private beta the same day. There was no new official Claude or Anthropic original on X today.

summary.zh: 自 11/6 起 changelog 仍无更新条目。页面置顶仍为 2026-11-06 Voice Chat with Agents——与 agent 实时语音通话，由 Grok Voice 驱动，可在 Agents 窗口、IDE、Web 与 iOS 使用。11/13 的公司博文《An update on our recent security incident》已在昨日技术动态写过。
summary.en: Still no new changelog entry since Nov 6. The page still leads with Voice Chat with Agents (2026-11-06): a realtime voice call with the agent, powered by Grok Voice, in the Agents Window, the IDE, on the web, and on iOS. The Nov 13 company post “An update on our recent security incident” was already covered in yesterday’s tech section.

summary.zh: 官方 changelog Latest 仍为 v1.0.1（2026-11-11，条目亦包含 1.0.0）：Team / Enterprise / Ultra 计划下，Bot 可从链接加入 Google Meet、Zoom 或 Microsoft Teams，在会议聊天中回复并会后发送摘要，并支持共享登录连接器等。Homebrew cask grok-bot 仍报 1.1.0（与昨日相同），下载地址指向 darwin-arm64 的 1.1.0 安装包，高于 changelog。按客户端与 changelog 对照规则，不以「近几日无新版本」表述；1.1.0 的功能说明官方尚未列出，故不编造。
summary.en: The official changelog Latest is still v1.0.1 from Nov 11 (the entry also includes 1.0.0): on Team / Enterprise / Ultra plans, the Bot can join Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams from a link, reply in meeting chat, send a recap afterward, and use shared-login connectors. The Homebrew cask grok-bot still reports 1.1.0 (same as yesterday), with a darwin-arm64 1.1.0 package, ahead of the changelog. Per the client-versus-changelog rule, this is not described as “no new version in recent days”; 1.1.0’s features have not been listed officially, so none are invented here.

A fresh check of the official page found the RSC and HTML byte-identical to yesterday’s capture, still led by Gemini 4 Carbon High (60.4% / $9.22), Carbon Medium (60.1%), and Fable 5.2 Max (60.0%).

summary.zh: 按得分÷单任务成本，性价比最高的仍是极低成本配置：GPT-5.6 Luna Low（16.0% / $0.03，约 533 分/$）和 Haiku 5.5 Low（30.9% / $0.08）。Gemini 4 Hydrogen Low（27.9% / $0.28，约 99.64 分/$）仍在性价比第 9。在分数更可用的区间，Haiku 5.5 High（42.3% / $0.32）和 Hydrogen Extra High（57.8% / $5.86，官方第 6，约 9.86 分/$）更均衡。官方得分仍由 Gemini 4 Carbon High（60.4% / $9.22）和 Carbon Medium（60.1%）领跑，随后是 Fable 5.2 Max（60.0%）；Hydrogen Extra High 与 Opus 5.5 Max 一同位于官方前 6。较昨日无更新。
summary.en: Ranked by score ÷ cost per task, the highest-value configs remain the cheapest ones: GPT-5.6 Luna Low (16.0% / $0.03, about 533 pts/$) and Haiku 5.5 Low (30.9% / $0.08). Gemini 4 Hydrogen Low (27.9% / $0.28, about 99.64 pts/$) stays at value #9. In a more usable score range, Haiku 5.5 High (42.3% / $0.32) and Hydrogen Extra High (57.8% / $5.86, official #6, about 9.86 pts/$) are more balanced. The official scoreboard is still led by Gemini 4 Carbon High (60.4% / $9.22) and Carbon Medium (60.1%), then Fable 5.2 Max (60.0%); Hydrogen Extra High remains with Opus 5.5 Max in the official top 6. No change versus yesterday.

text.zh: 今日重心（周一去敏）：工作日推进生产架构细节与上线规划重构（端云接口与版本资源规划仍在进行），并梳理主要功能迁移情况；上午更新双周 native 周报，晚上更新架构基准，同时记录团队投入。学习侧继续技术文章阅读，并安排安全架构课（信任边界）以及 harness / pstack 方向的研究；实体硬件上的语音问答按计划穿插。
text.en: Monday focus (sanitized): on the work side, continue the production-architecture and launch-planning refactor (device-cloud interfaces and version/resource planning are still in progress), and review the status of major feature migration; update the biweekly native report in the morning and the architecture benchmark in the evening, and log team capacity. On the learning side, keep up with technical reading, and schedule the security-architecture lesson on trust boundaries plus harness / pstack study; hardware voice-QA work is slotted in as planned.
